Class StringHttpMessageConverter

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.http.converter.AbstractHttpMessageConverter<String>
org.springframework.http.converter.StringHttpMessageConverter
All Implemented Interfaces:
HttpMessageConverter<String>
public class StringHttpMessageConverter extends AbstractHttpMessageConverter<String>
Implementation of HttpMessageConverter that can read and write strings.

默认情况下，此转换器支持所有媒体类型（*/*），并以 Content-Type 为 text/plain 进行写入。可以通过设置 supportedMediaTypes 属性来覆盖此行为。

Since:
3.0
Author:
Arjen Poutsma，Juergen Hoeller

    • setWriteAcceptCharset

      public void setWriteAcceptCharset(boolean writeAcceptCharset)
      Whether the Accept-Charset header should be written to any outgoing request sourced from the value of Charset.availableCharsets(). The behavior is suppressed if the header has already been set.

      自 5.2 版本起，默认值设置为false。

    • addDefaultHeaders

      protected void addDefaultHeaders(HttpHeaders headers, String s, @Nullable MediaType type) throws IOException
      描述从类复制：AbstractHttpMessageConverter
      Add default headers to the output message.

      此实现若未提供内容类型，则委托给 AbstractHttpMessageConverter.getDefaultContentType(Object)；如有必要，设置默认字符集；调用 AbstractHttpMessageConverter.getContentLength(T, MediaType)；并设置相应的标头。

      Throws:
